extracted.name: Ginger Soy Salmon Patties
extracted.description: These easy salmon patties are flavored with ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, and five-spice powder for a quick, family-friendly weeknight dinner.
ingredient_lines: 2 (5 ounce) cans salmon, drained and flaked
1 tablespoon sesame oil, or as needed
instruction_lines: Mix salmon, panko, bell pepper, green onions, eggs, ginger, soy sauce, sesame seeds, and five-spice powder together in a bowl until well-combined. Form mixture into 4 patties.

Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Working in batches, cook patties in the hot skillet until browned, 4 to 5 minutes. Flip and brown on the other side, 4 to 5 more minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate to drain.
